checks: Twelve separated functional zones; expanded static/dynamic colliders and actual visual parameters
Container, barrier, rotor, drum, crates, slalom and final chain collide and resolve penetration without forward skips
Predictable continuous hazards warn before activating and always leave at least one safe lane
Narrow bridge and fork divider have physical response; no landmark collider on route
Two-tier ramp and gap clear using native impulse at 9/12/23/31m/s
Rescue is backward and finite, preserves inventory/charges/tokens/answers and cannot skip checkpoint
Safe branch needs no jump; risky crossing pays exactly once only after airborne crossing and landing
Oil is temporary, Grip mitigates it, Radar uses current visible hazards, every stage clock freezes on quiz/pause
